payload.notes: Gemma 4 26B A4B instruction Q8 GGUF on one Intel Arc Pro B70 via llama.cpp SYCL. Validation: chat canary 96 repeats x 4 cases = 384/384 pass with REASONING=off. Benchmark requested max_tokens=512 but model stopped naturally; actual mean completion tokens 155.6 (min 124, max 177) with prompt tokens 574. Throughput uses server-reported usage.completion_tokens after TTFT, not guessed token counts. This improves the local Q8 baseline from 26.10 tok/s to 41.81 tok/s. No speculative decode; MTP n=2/4/8 smokes were slower. Evidence: https://github.com/steveseguin/b70-optimization-lab/blob/main/results/gemma4-26b-a4b-q8-b70/README.md and data/gemma4-q8-gpu0-syclopt0-faoff-deep-20260623T0715/summary.json.
